what: The center image window and the one-line list passing over it advance together by exactly one line (23px) per wheel notch — they follow the target position by 9% per frame and glide to a stop. Lines fade by distance from the center 1 → .8 → .5 → .2 → .1, and only the center line is bright with a ▶ in front. The image strip steps by 80% of the window height so the images above and below peek in slightly, and the images shift with parallax inside the window. The wheel filters out the inertia tail (strength under 4 · repeats within 200ms · decreasing strength discarded) so one gesture moves just one line. Touch: a swipe over 16px moves one line, and arrow keys also move one line. When the line changes it fires fx:pick(detail.index), and pressing the center line or image fires fx:open

options.gap: Image step = Window height × (1 + gap), default -.2 (on phone width, give .25 and they move on separated)
options.start: Initial line index to slide in, default 3 (from the fourth line to the first) — 0 starts still
options.[data-fx-part=list]: List holding the lines (required) — moves via translate
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Image slot in the same order as the row (optional) — placed vertically on the band. The video inside plays only when centered
options.[data-fx-part=window]: Image window (parent of the image cells, optional)
options.fx:pick · fx:open: When the center row changes · when the center row or image is pressed (bubble, detail.index)

from.where: index.html .hw (Hero — ten rows of work · row 23px · video window 817:469)

note: Receives wheel and arrow keys across the whole panel (for a one-screen hero where the page does not scroll). Touch is not hijacked — keep the panel within the screen height
